verdict.rationale: Requesty is explicitly documented as an OpenAI-compatible unified API/gateway supporting 300+ (or 600+) models via a single base_url swap, with routing, fallback, load balancing, and BYOK across providers, all first-party documented and corroborated by an llms.txt probe describing it as a unified LLM gateway. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification beyond docs, and no public OpenAPI spec found (404s on probe).
